text: Bhai log, next month long weekend aa raha hai! Koi mast road trip plan karein?
Yaar mujhe break chahiye is brutal sprint ke baad. Goa chalte hain, beach vibes!
Bhai Goa October mein bohot humid aur bheed hogi. North chalte hain Himachal side?
Shimla ya Manali? Manali has that Solang valley pass and cleaner air.
Arre haan Manali sounds incredible! Mere cousin ne Old Manali mein riverside wooden cottage li thi ekdum river ke paas.
Friday chutti milegi kya par? Last moment manager ka kalesh nahi chahiye mujhe.
Haan bhai, Friday ko Dussehra ki official holiday hai, so 3 days sorted bina PTO liye.
Airbnb link bhej rahi hoon... check karo balcony ke samne private apple orchard hai.
Dekhne mein toh bohot sundar hai. Split karke 2500 per head per night, budget mein hai.
Done hai meri taraf se! Lock karo jaldi warna dates nikal jayengi.
Count me in 100%! Apni gadi se chalenge ya Volvo bus le lein?
Card swipe karke cottage book kar di 5 logo ki! Garam jackets pack kar lo sab log!
Yesssss maza aayega, finally trip ho rahi hai! So hyped!
Legend Rohan bhai! Advance UPI kar dunga raat ko.
Aaj dinner mein kya mangwaye? Spicy chicken biryani ya sushi?
Ghar pe maggi aur chai bana raha hoon. Trip ke liye paise bacha raha hoon haha.
Bhai Kabir, free hai kya call ya chat pe baat karne ke liye?
Haan bhai bol na, sab theek na? Tension lag raha hai.
Honestly, had the most crushing day today. Startup ne humari poori division ko layoff kar diya.
Arre yaar... Rahul, this is devastating news. Mujhe zara bhi idea nahi tha company itni shaky hai.
2 saal se 60-60 ghante kaam kiya is product pe. Poora drained, khali feel ho raha hai, dimag sunn pad gaya hai.
Bhai lambi saans le. You are one of the sharpest engineers. Leadership ka failure hai ye, tera worth isse define nahi hota. Main tere ghar aa raha hoon.
Thanks bhai, bohot zaroori tha sunna ye. Mind bohot heavy aur dark zone mein chala gaya tha.
15 min mein aa raha hoon garam khana leke. Tension mat le, we will face this together bro.
True brother Kabir. Dil se shukriya yaar, means a lot.
Guys kal ka IPL cricket match dekha kya? Last over mein kya insane thriller tha!
Arre haan bhai, 2 balls pe 10 runs chahiye the aur sixer maar ke jeeta diya!
Rahul bhai, Rishikesh outdoor trip kaisa raha? Rafting kiya kya weekend pe?
Bhai tu vishwas nahi karega, kal subah river rapids pe kya kaand kiya humne!
Sach mein grade 4 stretch pe white water rafting attempt kiya kya?
HAAN BHAI! Instructor ne pehle 35 feet upar se river gorge mein cliff jump karwaya! Poora adrenaline rush, dil gale mein aa gaya tha!
Bap re bap! Tu toh absolute daredevil hai haha! Paani thanda nahi tha kya?

Glacial meltwater, sui jaisa chub raha tha! Fir whirlpools mein raft do baar almost palti. Pure wilderness thrill. Next summer high-altitude mountain pass expedition saath chalenge, koi bahana nahi chalega.
Pakka chalenge bhai! Wild mountain terrain conquer karne ka nasha hi alag hai.
Reminder: 3 baje quarterly planning sync hai, presentations ready rakhna sabhi.
Drive folder pe slides update kardi hain maine.
Weekend pe Murthal chalein kya late night drive pe? Aloo pyaaz ke paranthe aur makkhan!
Haan bhai white butter wale garam paranthe aur kulhad wali chai, best combination at 2 AM.
Count me in too! Thoda mind fresh ho jayega drive karke.
Main gaadi nikalta hoon 11:30 PM, sabko pick kar lunga!
